```{=html}
<div class="screen-only">
  <b>WS-07-cost-vs-value-gate</b> &middot; review copy &middot; declared format <b>A4 portrait</b> &middot;
  2 sheet(s). Each white page below is one physical sheet at true size.
  Anything spilling past a page edge onto this grey background is a layout defect.
</div>

<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>The Cost-vs-Value Gate — Approval Card for a Funded Workflow</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A standing approval card, one per workflow, that separates a governed spend from an ungoverned one and leaves an auditable record of each intentional bet.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-07-cost-vs-value-gate</b><br>
      Pack C - The case and the money<br>
      fill order <b>11</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>mixed</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>The Agentic SDLC Bill</b>, <i>Pool the spend, gate the bets</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch07-the-agentic-sdlc-bill.qmd</code> L98 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch07-the-agentic-sdlc-bill.html#sec-bill-spend-pooling">#sec-bill-spend-pooling</a>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill one card for each proposed workflow. Complete it at install time, and complete it again at run
    time. Work down the numbered fields: the named owner drafts it, and the approver in field 16 signs it.
    Complete <code>WS-07-spend-pool-budget-model</code> first &mdash; field 3 picks from its four pools.
    The pool owner named in field 3 is in the room when you approve.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Is it a bet, and is it justified? <span class="ws-block-note">fields 1&ndash;8</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:5%"><col style="width:19%"><col style="width:26%"><col style="width:50%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b>Workflow name</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b>Gate stage</b></td>
          <td class="prior">The chapter gates at both install time and run time.<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">install time</span><span class="opt">run time</span></div><br>Tick the stage this completion covers.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>Spend pool it draws on</b></td>
          <td class="prior">Frontier R&amp;D / Per-workflow run / Everyday prompting / Local models<span class="prior-src">ch07 L102-105</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Frontier R&amp;D</span><span class="opt">Per-workflow run</span><span class="opt">Everyday prompting</span><span class="opt">Local models</span></div>Spell it exactly as on <code>WS-07-spend-pool-budget-model</code>.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td><b>Fast path?</b></td>
          <td class="prior">The chapter waves through workflows that run locally on local models, or whose cost gradient is low and well-evaluated.<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>fast path</span> Tick only if <b>both</b> tests are met: local or low-gradient, <b>and</b> evaluated.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">5</span></td>
          <td><b>Evaluation evidence for the fast path</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span>What &ldquo;well-evaluated&rdquo; means for this workflow, and where that evaluation lives.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">6</span></td>
          <td><b>Expected outcome</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span>What the workflow is for, in outcome terms, not activity terms.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">7</span></td>
          <td><b>Does the expected outcome justify the inferencing bill?</b></td>
          <td class="prior"><b>&ldquo;does the expected outcome justify the inferencing bill?&rdquo;</b><span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">yes</span><span class="opt">no</span><span class="opt">not yet evidenced</span></div>Tick one.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">8</span></td>
          <td><b>Named owner</b></td>
          <td class="prior">The chapter requires an owner before it ships.<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span>A named individual.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div>WS-07-cost-vs-value-gate &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 1 of 2</div>
    <div>Filled by <span style="display:inline-block;width:40mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span>
      &nbsp; Date <span style="display:inline-block;width:24mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span></div>
  </div>

</div>

<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>The Cost-vs-Value Gate — Approval Card for a Funded Workflow</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Reverse side: cost, stop condition, off-switch, approval and re-check.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-07-cost-vs-value-gate</b><br>
      Pack C - The case and the money<br>
      fill order <b>11</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>mixed</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Cost, controls and approval <span class="ws-block-note">fields 9&ndash;19</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:5%"><col style="width:19%"><col style="width:26%"><col style="width:50%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">9</span></td>
          <td><b>Expected cost per run</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-currency" data-symbol="$"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">10</span></td>
          <td><b>Expected runs per month</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">11</span></td>
          <td><b>Expected cost per month</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="field 9 &times; field 10"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">12</span></td>
          <td><b>Stop condition</b></td>
          <td class="prior">The chapter requires one before it ships.<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span>The specific, observable condition at which this workflow stops.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">13</span></td>
          <td><b>Off-switch</b></td>
          <td class="prior">The chapter requires one before it ships.<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span>The named mechanism, who can pull it, and how quickly it takes effect.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">14</span></td>
          <td><b>Monitoring that tells us whether the bet paid off</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&ldquo;a bet is only sound once your monitoring can tell you whether it paid off&rdquo;<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span>The specific dashboard, report or trace &mdash; one that exists.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">15</span></td>
          <td><b>Reversibility</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src"><code>WS-05-decision-rights-gate-matrix</code></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">reversible</span><span class="opt">recoverable at cost</span><span class="opt">irreversible</span></div>Use the vocabulary of <code>WS-05-decision-rights-gate-matrix</code> unchanged.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">16</span></td>
          <td><b>Approver</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill tall"><span class="f-owner"></span><span class="f-sign"></span>Who approved at install; re-signed at the run-time re-check.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">17</span></td>
          <td><b>Install-time approval date</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">18</span></td>
          <td><b>Next run-time re-check date</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">ch07 L98</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div>Mandatory. A card with no re-check date is a one-time approval, not a gate.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">19</span></td>
          <td><b>Register line</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="workflow / pool / owner / expected monthly cost / next re-check date"></span>Filed with the organization&rsquo;s decision record.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot-quote">
    "Any spend beyond the baseline playbook is an intentional bet — and a bet is only sound
    once your monitoring can tell you whether it paid off." (ch07 L98)
  </div>
```
